user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Web pages surfaced in ChatGPT search answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited during user-initiated requests and GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for model development and AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content in response to Claude user questions.
user_agents.scope: Web content accessed through user-initiated queries and searches.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve user search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online content indexed to enhance relevance and accuracy of search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes and product-specific crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images, logos, favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Image or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls videos for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Video or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-News or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler used by product teams for fetching publicly accessible content.
user_agents.scope: Various product teams for internal research and development and one-off crawls.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Version of GoogleOther optimized for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible image URLs for various product teams and research.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Version of GoogleOther optimized for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible video URLs for various product teams and research.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls site content usage for training Gemini models and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet to deliver search experience.
user_agents.scope: Operates either automatically or in response to user requests to index information.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage access via robots.txt tags or WAF configuration.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: Operates in response to user requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage access via robots.txt tags or WAF configuration.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and crawls web data.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models powering generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent determining data usage for AI training; does not crawl.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays app or website information including title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for use cases like improving advertising and other business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to train foundation AI models and index content.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Supports agentic AI capabilities including helping AI navigate websites to complete tasks for users.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs fetches requested by the user.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to build index for Bing search and AI features.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible websites and web pages across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify Disallow rules for bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates snapshots and previews of web pages in real time.
user_agents.scope: Web pages requested for preview generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify Disallow rules for BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls host-level web pages to improve Amazon products, services, and AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives and robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Used to improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content to appear in search experiences like Alexa without training generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information on user's behalf; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing an open copy of Internet data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web for researchers, companies, and individuals.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: CCBot or request addition to opt-out registry.
